units.title: Purpose: to + verb
units.rule: Nima uchun qilganimizni aytish uchun *to + feʼl* ishlatamiz: *I went to the shop to buy bread.* — Men non sotib olish uchun doʻkonga bordim. Oʻzbekchadagi "…ish uchun" inglizchada *to + feʼl* boʻladi. *for* bilan aytilmaydi: *to buy* toʻgʻri, *for buy* notoʻgʻri. Feʼl doim asosiy shaklda turadi: *to play* (*to playing* emas). Savol: *Why did you go to the shop?* — *To buy bread.*
examples: I went to the shop to buy bread.
Dilnoza goes to school to teach English.
Bekzod went to the park to play football.
We went to Samarkand to see our friends.
Aziz studies every day to learn English.
Why did you go to the market? To buy apples.

text.title: A trip to Jizzax
text.en: Yesterday Karim went to Jizzax. He went there to buy a new phone. Nodira went with him to see her sister. Bekzod went to the park to play football. Dilnoza stayed at home to cook dinner. Aziz came to her house to study English. In the evening they ate dinner together. Hamida went to bed early to sleep well.
